In this lexicon

  • damn!

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Att. 5.20.1: quī, malum! istī Pindenissītae quī sunt?; Plaut. Amph. 604: Quās, malum, nūgās?

Examples

  • quī, malum! istī Pindenissītae quī sunt? inquiēs; nōmen audīvī numquam.

    “Who the devil are these Pindenissitae?” you’ll say; “I never heard the name.”Cic. Att. 5.20.1
